title: Office Administrator
description:
Office Administrator

Location: Uddingston, Glasgow

Salary: 27,500 - 30,000

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm

Job Type: Permanent

Are you an organised and proactive administrator looking for a varied role within a friendly and supportive team? We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established and successful business seeking an Office Administrator to support the smooth day-to-day running of its operations.

We're looking for someone who has:
- Previous administration experience, ideally within transport, logistics, construction, or a similar industry.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with customers and colleagues.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
- The ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a team-focused approach.

- Competitive salary of 27,500 - 33,000, depending on experience.
- Monday to Friday working hours - 8:00am to 4:30pm.
- Friendly, supportive, and fun working environment.
- Positive company culture where employees are valued.
- Full training provided for hire desk responsibilities.
- Opportunity to develop your skills and build a long-term career.

If you're looking for a varied administration role with a growing business that values teamwork and offers excellent career stability, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Digital Helpdesk Support Apprentice
description:
DS Business Solutions is a leading provider of managed print services, document solutions, and IT support services. We work with organisations across a range of sectors, helping them improve productivity through innovative technology solutions, expert support, and outstanding customer service.

Our team supports customers with multifunctional devices (MFDs), business software, digital systems, and technical services. We pride ourselves on building long-term relationships with our customers, providing reliable support and tailored solutions to meet their needs.

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated apprentice to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to develop a career in IT and customer support while working towards a nationally recognised Digital Applications Support qualification.

About the role:

You will act as the first point of contact for customers requiring technical assistance and support. You will help users resolve a variety of digital and technology-related issues whilst developing valuable skills in troubleshooting, customer service, digital systems, and IT support.

Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will gain hands-on experience supporting customers both remotely and on-site, building technical knowledge across a range of systems, software applications, and business technologies.

Responsibilities:
- Act as the first point of contact for customer technical support enquiries via telephone, email, and digital support systems
- Log, monitor, update, and manage support tickets using the company's service management platform
- Develop expertise in DS Business Solutions' key business systems, including MPS Estate Management System, IT Database, Select Billing System, Service Logging System, Konica Minolta software applications and customer support tools
- Support customers with printing, scanning, networking, software, and connectivity issues
- Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, resolving first-line support requests wherever possible
- Escalate more complex technical issues to senior engineers and specialist support teams when required
- Assist with the installation, configuration, and maintenance of multifunctional devices (MFDs) and associated software solutions
- Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, support requests, resolutions, and technical updates
- Use digital tools and systems to monitor workloads, prioritise support requests, and track service delivery
- Produce reports and update system records to ensure data accuracy and service quality
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues and suggesting improvements to systems and processes

Required skills:
- A full, clean UK driving licence is required due to the field-based nature of the role
- Willingness to travel to customer sites as required
- A genuine interest in technology, IT support, and digital systems
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Eagerness to learn and develop new technical skills

Working hours: 8.30am - 5.30pm, Monday to Friday

What we offer:

We are committed to developing talent and helping our people build rewarding careers. You'll be joining a supportive team where you can learn from experienced professionals, gain industry-recognised qualifications, and play an important role in delivering exceptional service to our customers.
- Company vehicle provided for business use
- Laptop, tablet, and mobile phone supplied
- Full training on Konica Minolta devices, software, and managed print technologies
- Support towards completing a Digital Helpdesk Support SCQF Level 6 apprenticeship
- Ongoing mentoring and development from experienced engineers and technical specialists
- Quarterly performance bonus scheme
- Opportunity to gain hands-on experience across IT support, customer service, digital systems, and managed print solutions
- Clear career progression opportunities within a growing technology business

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

This vocational apprenticeship comprehensively supports your specific job role with this particular employer. You will join a collaborative project and programme environment where effective governance, accurate information and strong PMO standards are central to successful delivery. Your new role

As Project Co-ordinator, you will provide hands-on operational support across the PMO. You will maintain accurate project information, keep governance activities running to schedule and take ownership of the administration that enables project managers to focus on delivery.

Your key responsibilities will include:
- Maintaining project and programme registers, including statuses, RAG ratings and key dates
- Coordinating weekly and monthly reporting and following up on late or incomplete submissions
- Producing governance packs, consolidated dashboards and senior-level reporting
- Taking minutes, recording actions and tracking them through to completion
- Supporting stage-gate and approval processes, including paperwork, sign-offs and audit trails
- Maintaining programme risk, issue, assumption and dependency logs
- Following up with owners on updates, mitigations and ageing actions
- Identifying cross-project dependencies, clashes and gaps between partner plans
- Maintaining project plans and milestone trackers using Microsoft Project and Jira
- Monitoring milestone slippage, baseline changes and portfolio-level milestones
- Supporting project replanning activities
- Maintaining resource allocation trackers and supporting resource planning
- Coordinating onboarding and offboarding for team members, contractors and suppliers
- Supporting timesheet completion where required
- Improving Jira governance by ensuring work is correctly ticketed and aligned with project plans
- Producing delivery, coverage, orphan, work-in-progress and flow reporting
- Carrying out ticket hygiene checks across epics, stories, tasks and required fields
- Managing document control, templates, versioning, folder structures and access through SharePoint
- Conducting periodic data-quality audits and supporting compliance with PMO standards
- Coordinating lessons-learned sessions and identifying opportunities to improve or automate PMO processes What you'll need to succeed You will have previous experience in a Project Co-ordinator, Project Support Officer, PMO Analyst, PMO Support or Business Support position, with the ability to manage multiple work streams and competing deadlines. You will also bring:
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- The ability to identify inconsistencies and quality issues within project data
- Clear, professional written communication suitable for senior stakeholders
